name: calendar-invite
description: Make .ics calendar files and add-to-calendar links for any event, including repeating events.

interface.longDescription:
An .ics file generator and add-to-calendar link maker for anyone sending an event: webinars, classes, parties, launches, deadlines, and course schedules.

Describe the event in plain words and InviteKit builds a calendar invite that imports cleanly into Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook and other calendar apps, plus ready-to-share add to calendar links for Google Calendar, Outlook.com, Office 365 and Yahoo Calendar. Paste the links into an email, a newsletter, an event page or a chat; attach the .ics file to an invitation.

Time zones are handled properly. Give the local time and the city (Warsaw, Chicago, Sydney) or zone name, and the file carries a full time zone definition, so attendees in other countries see the right local time, including the weeks when daylight saving time starts or ends. Times that are skipped or repeated when clocks change are explained. Optionally list your attendees' cities to see their local times next to yours.

Recurring meeting invites: daily, weekly on chosen weekdays (every Tuesday and Thursday), every other week, monthly by date or by weekday (the second Tuesday, the last Friday, the last working day of the month), and yearly (the fourth Thursday of November). End after a number of times or on a date, and skip holidays or cancelled dates. The card lists the next dates of the series and the last one.

Create an ics file with multiple events: give a list of session dates (a course, training plan, match fixtures, conference agenda) and get one file that adds every session at once.

Also included: all-day and multi-day events, events that end after midnight, location, details, a meeting or event link, organizer name, and up to three reminders.

Every file follows the iCalendar standard (RFC 5545): correct line folding and escaping for commas, semicolons and accented or non-Latin text, stable event IDs, and standard recurrence rules (RRULE) that calendar apps expand the same way.

Limitations: InviteKit makes files and links only. It does not email invitations, add attendees, track replies, or read or change your calendar. The Outlook.com, Office 365 and Yahoo links add the first date of a repeating event; the .ics file and the Google Calendar link add the whole series. Reminders are kept in the .ics file; web links use each calendar's default reminders.
defaultPrompt: Make an .ics file and add-to-calendar links for 'Product launch webinar', 2026-11-05, 18:30-20:00 Warsaw time
Calendar invite for a yoga class every Tue and Thu, 7-8am Chicago time, 10 sessions starting 2026-10-27
One calendar file for my Spanish course: 2027-01-12, 01-19 and 01-26, 18:00-19:30 London time, Room 4

positive.description: Single event with reminder and an attendee's local time
positive.prompt: Make a calendar invite for 'Product launch webinar' on 2026-11-05 from 18:30 to 20:00 Warsaw time with a 30-minute reminder, and show the time in New York
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar_event with title Product launch webinar, start 2026-11-05T18:30, end 20:00, time_zone Warsaw, reminders_minutes_before [30], viewer_time_zones [New York]. Returns Thu 5 Nov 2026, 18:30-20:00 CET (UTC+1, Europe/Warsaw); New York sees 12:30-14:00 EST. The card shows a date badge, a Download .ics button (file with a Europe/Warsaw time zone definition and a reminder 30 minutes before) and Google, Outlook.com, Office 365 and Yahoo buttons.

positive.description: Weekly repeating class across a daylight saving change, with a skipped date
positive.prompt: Create a calendar invite for a yoga class every Tuesday and Thursday 7:00-8:00 am Chicago time, 10 sessions starting 2026-10-27, skipping 2026-11-26
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar_event with start 2026-10-27T07:00, end 08:00, time_zone Chicago, recurrence weekly on TU and TH, count 10, exceptions [2026-11-26]. The repeat rule is FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU,TH;COUNT=10 with 2026-11-26 skipped, so 9 events, the last on 2026-11-24. The next dates list 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-29 at 07:00 CDT (UTC-5) and, from 2026-11-03, 07:00 CST (UTC-6), with a note that clocks change and the class stays at 07:00 local time. It notes that the Outlook.com, Office 365 and Yahoo links add the first date only.

positive.description: Monthly meeting on the second Tuesday with an end date
positive.prompt: I need an .ics file for our board meeting on the second Tuesday of every month, 10:00-12:00 New York time, starting 2026-11-10, until 2027-06-30
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar_event with start 2026-11-10T10:00, end 12:00, time_zone New York, recurrence monthly, monthly_on nth_weekday, nth 2, weekdays [TU], until 2027-06-30. The rule is FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=2TU;UNTIL=20270701T035959Z (the end of 30 Jun 2027 in New York, in UTC): 8 events, the last on 2027-06-08. The first dates are 2026-11-10, 2026-12-08, 2027-01-12, 2027-02-09 and 2027-03-09, each 10:00-12:00 EST.

positive.prompt: Add-to-calendar links for the 'Design Summit' conference, all day from 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-07, location Lisbon
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_calendar_event with title Design Summit, start 2026-11-05, end 2026-11-07, location Lisbon. Returns an all-day event Thu 5 Nov 2026 to Sat 7 Nov 2026 (3 days). The .ics uses date values with an exclusive end (DTEND 20261108), and the Google Calendar link uses dates 20261105/20261108, so every calendar shows 3 full days. Outlook.com, Office 365 and Yahoo links are marked all day.

positive.prompt: Make one calendar file for my Spanish A1 evening course: 2027-01-12, 2027-01-19 and 2027-01-26, 18:00-19:30 London time, in Room 4, with a 1-hour reminder
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_event_series with calendar_name Spanish A1 evening course, time_zone London, location Room 4, a reminder of one hour, and 3 events starting 2027-01-12T18:00, 2027-01-19T18:00 and 2027-01-26T18:00, each ending 19:30. Returns 3 events from 2027-01-12 to 2027-01-26, each Tue 18:00-19:30 GMT in Room 4 with a reminder 1 hour before, and one .ics download that adds all 3 sessions at once.

negative.description: Reading a calendar is out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant explains this app makes calendar files and links but cannot see the user's calendar.
negative.prompt: What's on my Google Calendar tomorrow?

negative.description: Finding a meeting time across time zones is a different task. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant helps without this app or suggests choosing a time first.
negative.prompt: Find a time next week when people in New York, London and Tokyo are all in working hours

negative.description: Changing or deleting existing calendar entries is out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant explains it cannot change the user's Outlook calendar.
negative.prompt: Delete the recurring standup from my Outlook calendar

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: RFC 5545 .ics files with time zone definitions, add-to-calendar links for Google Calendar, Outlook.com, Office 365 and Yahoo, repeating events with end dates and skipped dates, attendee local times, reminders, and multi-session schedule files.

pl-PL.subtitle: Pliki .ics i linki kalendarza
pl-PL.description: Generator plików .ics i linków "dodaj do kalendarza" dla każdego wydarzenia: webinarów, zajęć, imprez, premier, terminów i harmonogramów kursów. Opisz wydarzenie, a InviteKit przygotuje zaproszenie, które poprawnie importuje się do Apple Calendar, Google Calendar i Outlooka, oraz linki do Google Calendar, Outlook.com, Office 365 i Yahoo. Strefy czasowe i zmiana czasu są uwzględniane: podaj lokalną godzinę i miasto, a plik zawiera pełną definicję strefy. Obsługuje wydarzenia cykliczne (codziennie, co tydzień w wybrane dni, co miesiąc według daty lub dnia tygodnia, np. ostatni piątek, co rok), z liczbą powtórzeń, datą końcową i pominiętymi datami, a także jeden plik z wieloma różnymi terminami. Ograniczenia: nie wysyła zaproszeń e-mailem i nie czyta ani nie zmienia Twojego kalendarza.

de-DE.subtitle: .ics-Dateien & Kalenderlinks
de-DE.description: Erstellt .ics-Kalenderdateien und "Zum Kalender hinzufügen"-Links für Webinare, Kurse, Feiern, Launches, Fristen und Kurspläne. Beschreibe den Termin, und InviteKit erstellt eine Einladung, die sich sauber in Apple Kalender, Google Kalender und Outlook importieren lässt, dazu Links für Google Kalender, Outlook.com, Office 365 und Yahoo. Zeitzonen und Sommerzeit werden korrekt berücksichtigt: Ortszeit und Stadt genügen, die Datei enthält die vollständige Zeitzonendefinition. Wiederkehrende Termine (täglich, wöchentlich an gewählten Tagen, monatlich nach Datum oder Wochentag wie dem letzten Freitag, jährlich) mit Anzahl, Enddatum und ausgelassenen Terminen sowie eine Datei mit vielen einzelnen Sitzungen. Einschränkungen: versendet keine Einladungen per E-Mail und liest oder ändert keinen Kalender.

es-ES.subtitle: Archivos .ics y enlaces
es-ES.description: Generador de archivos .ics y enlaces "añadir al calendario" para webinars, clases, fiestas, lanzamientos, plazos y calendarios de cursos. Describe el evento e InviteKit crea una invitación que se importa correctamente en Apple Calendar, Google Calendar y Outlook, además de enlaces para Google Calendar, Outlook.com, Office 365 y Yahoo. Gestiona zonas horarias y cambios de hora: indica la hora local y la ciudad, y el archivo incluye la definición completa de la zona. Admite eventos periódicos (diarios, semanales en días elegidos, mensuales por fecha o por día de la semana como el último viernes, anuales) con número de repeticiones, fecha final y fechas omitidas, y un solo archivo con varias sesiones distintas. Limitaciones: no envía invitaciones por correo ni lee o modifica tu calendario.

fr-FR.subtitle: Fichiers .ics et liens agenda
fr-FR.description: Générateur de fichiers .ics et de liens "ajouter à l'agenda" pour webinaires, cours, fêtes, lancements, échéances et plannings de formation. Décrivez l'événement et InviteKit crée une invitation qui s'importe proprement dans Apple Calendrier, Google Agenda et Outlook, ainsi que des liens pour Google Agenda, Outlook.com, Office 365 et Yahoo. Fuseaux horaires et changements d'heure sont gérés : indiquez l'heure locale et la ville, le fichier contient la définition complète du fuseau. Événements récurrents (quotidiens, hebdomadaires certains jours, mensuels par date ou par jour comme le dernier vendredi, annuels) avec nombre d'occurrences, date de fin et dates exclues, et un seul fichier pour plusieurs séances différentes. Limites : n'envoie pas d'invitations par e-mail et ne lit ni ne modifie votre agenda.

ja-JP.subtitle: .icsファイルとカレンダーリンク
ja-JP.description: ウェビナー、授業、パーティー、ローンチ、締め切り、講座スケジュールなど、あらゆるイベントの.icsファイルと「カレンダーに追加」リンクを作成します。イベント内容を伝えるだけで、Appleカレンダー、Googleカレンダー、Outlookに正しく取り込める招待ファイルと、Googleカレンダー、Outlook.com、Office 365、Yahooのリンクを用意します。現地時刻と都市を指定すれば、タイムゾーン定義を含むファイルになり、夏時間の切り替えも正確です。繰り返し予定（毎日、指定曜日の毎週、日付または「最終金曜日」などの毎月、毎年）に回数・終了日・除外日を設定でき、複数の異なる日程を1つのファイルにまとめることもできます。制限：招待メールの送信や、カレンダーの閲覧・変更は行いません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Arquivos .ics e links
pt-BR.description: Gerador de arquivos .ics e links "adicionar à agenda" para webinars, aulas, festas, lançamentos, prazos e cronogramas de cursos. Descreva o evento e o InviteKit cria um convite que importa corretamente no Apple Calendar, Google Agenda e Outlook, além de links para Google Agenda, Outlook.com, Office 365 e Yahoo. Fusos horários e horário de verão são tratados corretamente: informe o horário local e a cidade, e o arquivo traz a definição completa do fuso. Eventos recorrentes (diários, semanais em dias escolhidos, mensais por data ou por dia da semana como a última sexta-feira, anuais) com número de repetições, data final e datas puladas, e um único arquivo com várias sessões diferentes. Limitações: não envia convites por e-mail nem lê ou altera sua agenda.
